verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for its sandbox and production /v1 bases and a publicly browsable reference of 134 endpoints with a "Try It!" panel. It also documents callable APIs such as Events and Evaluations, a sandbox request mode and versioned /v1 servers with deprecation callouts, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a published API changelog or deprecation policy (access is also gated behind customer keys).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin (servers sandbox.alloy.co/v1 and api.alloy.co/v1).
The ReadMe-hosted API reference (134 endpoint pages, publicly browsable) runs the "Try It!" request panel with SDK snippets enabled
Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
Alloy provides a /healthcheck endpoint that confirms basic API connectivity.
